title: Expired first patent and a new second patent (raised by Flint Dibble)
summary: Filippo tells of Expired first patent and a new second patent (raised by Flint Dibble), about an unknown time at United States (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Yes, my initial patent at the moment is expired.

plain: An inventor and researcher named Filippo, who appeared on a podcast about a claimed energy grid beneath the pyramids of Egypt, responds to a point raised by an archaeologist, Flint Dibble, in a video. Filippo says that yes, his first patent, filed with the US Patent and Trademark Office (the government office that grants patents), has now expired, and that he has a second, newer patent. He tells it to show that his work still stands on official ground despite the criticism.
